item.title: msdplatform(.)com: Bafin warns consumers about website
item.description: The Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin) warns consumers about the services offered on the website msdplatform(.)com. Bafin has information that the operators are offering banking business and/or financial services on this website without the required authorisation. The operators of the website are not supervised by Bafin.

item.title: Publication of financial reports: Federal Office of Justice imposes disciplinary fine on H2 Core AG
item.description: On 17 June 2026, the Federal Office of Justice (Bundesamt für Justiz) imposed a disciplinary fine amounting to 50.000 euros on H2 Core AG.

item.title: rollincapital(.)com: Bafin warns consumers about website
item.description: The Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin) warns consumers about the services offered on the website rollincapital(.)com. Bafin suspects the unknown operators of the website of offering consumers financial and investment services without the required authorisation. The operators claim that they are based in Baar, Switzerland, and Munich, Germany.

item.title: Operation Hope AI und Vexorylax: Bafin warns consumers about WhatsApp groups used in a case of identity fraud
item.description: According to information available to the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin), unknown persons are currently using WhatsApp groups and chats to contact German investors.

item.title: rheinbridge(.)capital: Bafin warns about website
item.description: The German Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin) warns about offers on the website rheinbridge(.)capital. It is suspected that the unknown operators are offering financial and crypto-asset services without the required authorisation.

item.title: 37mh(.)com: Bafin warns consumers about website

The website does not have a valid imprint, and the claim of being regulated by Bafin is untrue.

item.title: pferdewetten.de AG: Bafin imposes administrative fine
item.description: On August 24, 2026, Bafin imposed an administrative fine totalling €250,000 on pferdewetten.de AG. The company had contravened obligations under the German Securities Trading Act (Wertpapierhandelsgesetz - WpHG). pferdewetten.de AG had failed to publish its half-yearly financial report for the financial year 2025 within the prescribed period.

item.title: elitguru(.)com: Bafin warns consumers about website
item.description: The Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin) warns consumers about the company ElitGuru and the services it is offering. item.title: rivolifinances(.)com: Bafin warns consumers about website
item.description: The Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin) warns consumers about the company Rivoli Finances and the services it is offering. The operators appear on the website under the names Rivoli S.A. and Rivoli Finances Sàrl and state that their alleged place of business is in Les Sables D’Olonne, France. Bafin suspects the unknown operators of using the website rivolifinances(.)com to offer loans to consumers and thus conduct banking business in Germany without the required authorisation.

item.title: Effecta GmbH: Bafin imposes administrative fine
item.description: On 30 July 2026, the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin) imposed an administrative fine amounting to €15,000 on Effecta GmbH. The reason for this fine was a breach of supervisory duties in connection with a contravention of Article 13(1) in conjunction with Article 14 of Regulation (EU) No 1286/2014 (PRIIPs Regulation). The company had offered the profit participation certificate “Companisto Green City Solutions Pre-Series B_2025_PPC.” for subscription to retail investors via a website in July 2025 without having published a key information document on the website beforehand.

item.title: Companisto Trust Service XXXV UG (haftungsbeschränkt): Bafin imposes administrative fine
item.description: On 30 July 2026, the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin) imposed an administrative fine amounting to €9,000 on Companisto Trust Service XXXV UG (haftungsbeschränkt). The reason for this fine was a breach of supervisory duties in connection with a contravention of Article 5(1) of Regulation (EU) No 1286/2014 (PRIIPs Regulation). Companisto Trust Service XXXV UG (haftungsbeschränkt), acting as a PRIIP manufacturer, had offered the profit participation certificate “Companisto Green City Solutions Pre-Series B_2025_PPC.” to retail investors for subscription via a website in July 2025 without having published a key information document on the website beforehand.
